achievements.name: Get Your Game Face On!
achievements.description: Where's your face, dingus? Get your butt to the avatar creator and sort yourself out!

achievements.name: So This Is the Battle Hub...
achievements.description: Welcome to the Battle Hub. Do enjoy yourself. That is the purpose for which it was built, after all.

achievements.name: First Encounters
achievements.description: Start with a match in the Battle Hub. Taking that first step is what matters the most.

achievements.name: There's Always Time for Training!
achievements.description: Done 30 matches in the Battle Hub? Keep at it! Nobody ever got sumo strong being shy of the ring!

achievements.name: King of the Ring
achievements.description: Getting used to this? Then try winning 30 Battle Hub matches. Gotta give yourself a challenge.

achievements.name: Jungle-Sized Surprise
achievements.description: Ever hear of Extreme Battles? They're more WILD than regular fights. Let your instincts take over!

achievements.name: Extreme Combat Training
achievements.description: If you can't adapt, you won't survive. Fight 20 Extreme Battles. It'll sharpen your judgement.

achievements.name: Over the Top Victory
achievements.description: 20 wins in Extreme Battle. Should be a snap for you! Stomp this flat, then aim even higher! Bwahaha!

achievements.name: Becoming the Avatar
achievements.description: In Avatar Battles, you can battle others as an avatar; a self outside of your self. Try it out!

achievements.name: Fixin' for a Fight
achievements.description: Nothing gets my engine revving like a brawl between avatars! Let's see you do 20 Avatar Battles!

achievements.name: The Struggle Over Self
achievements.description: A new form of combat, with a different path to victory. Win 20 Avatar Battles. Fight and grow.

achievements.name: Gazing at the Peak
achievements.description: You wanna match the one-and-only Jamie Siu? You'd better get up early. Give a Tournament a shot!

achievements.name: Steely Determination
achievements.description: The will to stand in the ring turns mind and muscle into steel! Enter five Tournaments! You'll see!

achievements.name: Dominating Like a Ninja
achievements.description: Even ninjas can't shortcut training. Win 10 matches in a Tournament. Not easy, but you can do it.

achievements.name: Veteran of Battle
achievements.description: Kung fu is ceaseless training. Fight in the Battle Hub 100 times, and you will see results.

achievements.name: Kickin' it Old School
achievements.description: You know they've got classic games at the Game Center? They might be old, but they still slap.

achievements.name: Classic Leaderboard Champ
achievements.description: Tried the Game Center's Ranking Challenge? Give it a shot! Always challenge yourself, even in games.

achievements.name: Entranced by Battle
achievements.description: Audiences turn mere fights into thrilling spectacles. Spectate a Battle Hub Match and witness glory.

achievements.name: Combat Analysis
achievements.description: In combat, you must constantly analyze the situation. Spectate an Extreme Battle, and watch closely.

achievements.name: Watching Gets Me PUMPED!
achievements.description: There's nothing quite like a fight, one-on-one, in the flesh! Go spectate an Avatar Battle!

achievements.name: Welcome to the Stable
achievements.description: Battle Hub Clubs are kinda like sumo stables! You should join one! I hope they have chanko stew...

achievements.name: Let the Praise Become Your Muscle
achievements.description: Hrrah! To fight before a roaring crowd is a wrestler's honor! Try earning a "Nice" fan of your own!

achievements.name: Gotta Be Popular! Uwo!
achievements.description: Uwo! My dream's to get famous! I bet if I get or send 200 "Nice!" marks, Mama'll be proud!

achievements.name: Spirits of Encouragement
achievements.description: Fans are like spirits; you feel stronger if you have them. Get or send 600 "Nice!" marks.

achievements.name: Pleased to Meet You!
achievements.description: Investigation or vacation, you can learn a lot by talking to people. Try chatting in the Battle Hub.

achievements.name: Coolheaded Analysis
achievements.description: Reviewing replays is a great way to learn from past fights. You're bound to make some discoveries.

achievements.name: My Title, My Life
achievements.description: Earned any titles for your efforts yet? Me? Pfft. I don't need a title. I'm Jamie freakin' Siu!

achievements.name: Joining the Pack
achievements.description: A lone wolf is strong, but they're far more fearsome in a pack. So go on—try making some friends!

achievements.name: Fashion Leader
achievements.description: Do you know who else never changes their clothes? Animals. Change your outfit. Please.

achievements.name: Ready to Dance?
achievements.description: Have you jammed out at the Battle Hub DJ Booth yet, bud? Turn up and light the dance floor aflame!

achievements.name: Up on the Big Screen
achievements.description: Sit down by the Battle Hub's big screen and see what's on show. Man... Used to be me up there.

achievements.name: Neighborhood Peacekeeper
achievements.description: Helping people in need's the secret to keeping any city peaceful. Go finish 22 sub-missions, got it?

achievements.name: Mastery's Bond
achievements.description: If you would call someone master, it is best to know them well. Raise the bond with a master to 100.

achievements.name: At Journey's End
achievements.description: Finished World Tour, did you? Congratulations are in order. I hope it was somehow meaningful to you.

achievements.name: Leaving the Nest
achievements.description: That's it for basic training! You're a full-fledged rookie now. Next move is up to you. Have fun!

achievements.name: Ha-dough-ken
achievements.description: I've worked a few odd jobs. They all doubled as training. You should try a part-time job, too.

achievements.name: Actions Speak Louder
achievements.description: Something in your way? Easy fix: send it flyin' with a Master Action! One of life's li'l pleasures.

achievements.name: The Grand Jeté of 100 Battles
achievements.description: Fight 100 FG online battles. Too difficult? If you're taking on the world, there is no other path.

achievements.name: Tales of the Valiant
achievements.description: Head to Fighting Ground and finish Arcade Mode once, buddy! Ya gotta hear fellow fighters' stories!

achievements.name: Practical Training
achievements.description: You know of Combo Trials, yes? Finish 45 of them. It will be difficult, but I've faith in you.

achievements.name: Fighting Fledgling
achievements.description: Swallows can fly super fast, right? Even they were chicks once. Get yourself to Training Mode!

achievements.name: Fighters' Codex
achievements.description: You seen these Character Guide things? Talk about rad! Bushinryu gets some rep too, naturally.

achievements.description: You want to learn the basics? I'm not in the mood to take on students. Go hit the Tutorials, kid.
